Minecraft names its next game drop: Wilderness Bound

The next drop adds outdoor exploration themes, abandoned camps, poplar forests and straw beds that skip the night without moving a player’s spawn point.

By PlayScout EditorialSeptember 5, 2026Source checked · Minecraft.net · Mojang
Player impact

The next drop adds outdoor exploration themes, abandoned camps, poplar forests and straw beds that skip the night without moving a player’s spawn point.

PRIMARY SOURCEMinecraft.net · MojangOpen the original announcement ↗

Explore, craft and build alone or with friends in the definitive block-based sandbox. This briefing keeps the player-facing consequence close to the source and links to the original announcement for complete details.

What was announced

Mojang has named the next Minecraft drop Wilderness Bound. The official preview centers on outdoor travel, a dappled forest, abandoned camps and tools for longer expeditions.

What it means for players

Straw beds are the clearest practical change shown so far: they let players skip the night without resetting their spawn point. That could make distant exploration safer without replacing a permanent home bed.

What to check next

The announced features are still coming to Bedrock and Java editions and may change while Mojang gathers feedback. Check the original announcement and future changelogs before planning a permanent world around preview behavior.
